name: dqf-driver-qualification-file-audit
title: 驾驶员资格档案审核
description: Use this skill when a motor-carrier safety director, DOT compliance manager, or third-party DQF administrator needs a pre-audit review of FMCSA Driver Qualification Files under 49 CFR § 391. Produces a DRAFT per-driver findings report and fleet-level rollup with prioritized remediation (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM) and a DER sign-off block.
